name: Transcriber
short_desc: Service: Shared local speech-to-text with word timings, OpenAI-compatible API.
author: Speaches (speaches-ai); packaged by Humanity Labs
description: Unmodified Speaches CPU server. One shared transcription service that Hermes and other apps call at /v1/audio/transcriptions. Runs locally; no paid API.

form_fields.label: Model to download on startup
form_fields.hint: Hugging Face faster-whisper model id. small is a good CPU default; Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3 or deepdml/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2 are more accurate but slower and need more RAM.
